tasks.label: Inspecter les ports 3000 et 3001
args: netstat -ano | findstr LISTENING | findstr ":3000" & netstat -ano | findstr LISTENING | findstr ":3001"

tasks.label: Arrêter tous les serveurs web
args: for /f "tokens=5" %P in ('netstat -ano ^| findstr LISTENING ^| findstr ":3000"') do taskkill /F /PID %P & for /f "tokens=5" %P in ('netstat -ano ^| findstr LISTENING ^| findstr ":3001"') do taskkill /F /PID %P & timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul & netstat -ano | findstr LISTENING | findstr ":3000" & netstat -ano | findstr LISTENING | findstr ":3001"

tasks.label: Arrêter les serveurs 3000 et 3001
args:
const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const ports=[3000,3001];let rows=[];try{rows=execFileSync('netstat',['-ano'],{encoding:'utf8'}).split(/?
/).filter(line=>/LISTENING/i.test(line));}catch(error){console.error('Impossible de lire les connexions Windows:',error.message);process.exit(1);}const pids=new Set();for(const line of rows){const match=line.trim().match(/^TCP\s+\S+:(\d+)\s+\S+\s+LISTENING\s+(\d+)$/i);if(match&&ports.includes(Number(match[1])))pids.add(Number(match[2]));}for(const pid of pids){try{console.log(`Arrêt du processus PID ${pid}`);execFileSync('taskkill',['/F','/PID',String(pid)],{stdio:'inherit'});}catch(error){console.error(`Échec de l’arrêt du PID ${pid}:`,error.message);process.exitCode=1;}}let remaining=[];try{remaining=execFileSync('netstat',['-ano'],{encoding:'utf8'}).split(/?
/).filter(line=>/LISTENING/i.test(line)&&ports.some(port=>new RegExp(`:\b${port}\s`).test(line)));}catch(error){console.error('Impossible de vérifier les ports:',error.message);process.exit(1);}if(remaining.length){console.error('Ports toujours occupés:',remaining.join('
'));process.exitCode=1;}else{console.log('Vérification terminée : aucun processus à l’écoute sur 3000 ou 3001.');}

tasks.label: Vérifier les deux ports
args: netstat -ano | findstr LISTENING | findstr ":3000" & netstat -ano | findstr LISTENING | findstr ":3001"

tasks.label: Vérifier compilation disponible
args: const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const id=path.join('.next','BUILD_ID');if(fs.existsSync(id)){console.log('Build disponible:',fs.readFileSync(id,'utf8').trim())}else{console.log('Build de production absent');process.exitCode=1}
